next_event.source: Phil Yeager: details of the new cost reduction and efficiency program to come 'when we report our final full year 2025 results and restated financials'; filings expected in Q4 2026; lender deadline 2026-11-30 (8-K 0001193125-26-391228, document_id 221393)

margin_framing.metric_basis_note: The only numeric cost framing is the prior team's $50M run-rate cost savings by end of 2025 (CFO Beth, Q3 2025 call); its horizon has passed and it was set on financials now being restated. The new program announced 2026-09-14 is unquantified. H1 2026 is guided to an operating loss before one-time charges, so no current margin level is available.

street.gap_assumption: No margin target, so no gap. Consensus looks stale: VA actuals stop at Q3 2025 (pre-restatement), and FY2026 consensus EBITDA of $310M (8.2% margin) was not reconciled to the company's guided H1 2026 operating loss. The 4m revision of -1.2% reflects no update, not stabilization. Calendar FY labels.
street.source: Baba data_financials consensus (summary); data_comps revisions asof 2026-10-01

evidence_of_progress.note: No reported Q1 or Q2 2026 financials (10-Qs delinquent). Preliminary release: revenue H1 2026 $1.70B to $1.80B, operating loss before one-time charges; fuel, rail and drayage costs ran ahead of rate increases implemented from Q3 2026. LTM 9.18% is VA actuals Q4 2024 to Q3 2025, all subject to restatement.

disqualifier_reason: Financial reporting and covenant stress: restatement of FY2023 to Q3 2025, 10-K and two 10-Qs delinquent, Nasdaq delisting determination expected, and a third credit agreement amendment (2026-09-11) needed to extend reporting deadlines to 2026-11-30 and add back restatement costs to covenant EBITDA. H1 2026 operating loss guided.
verdict: Disqualified: an accounting restatement, delinquent filings, expected Nasdaq delisting notice and a covenant amendment outweigh the new external CFO-elect and the founder's return as CEO; the score is not meaningful until restated numbers exist.
open_questions: Do the restated 2023 to 2025 financials and the FY2025 10-K land before the 2026-11-30 lender deadline and the Nasdaq hearing?
How large is the restatement, and what does it imply for true run-rate EBITDA margin vs the 8.2% FY2026 consensus?
Will the new efficiency program come with a dollar or margin target and a date when restated results are released?
